description: This PHP class 'LiveReloadListener' implements an event subscriber that injects a livereload script into HTML responses during development, listening specifically to kernel response events.

classes.name: LiveReloadListener
classes.description: Implements an event subscriber that injects livereload scripts into HTML responses during development.

methods.name: onKernelResponse
methods.description: Handles the kernel response event by injecting a livereload script into HTML responses if conditions are met.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array specifying the kernel response event with a low priority to trigger the response handling method.
